payload.title: A new site starts with working editorial policies
payload.description: When a site backend is created (and, once, for existing sites that have none), the AI-writing-tells starter pack is imported as enabled policies, so checks find something on day one; plain-language and asd-ste100 stay one click (or one CLI command) away. Idempotent: never re-adds or overwrites a policy an admin edited or deleted. Administration shows where each came from (source starter:<pack>). CLI: papyrus editorial policies list / import-starter <pack>.
